about: The 31 crossings of Lesson 1.10: everything that enters the Inbox Assistant across its boundary -- 10 user requests in, 8 tool results back, 13 records read back from rest -- each authored as an intended form and the wild form that actually arrives, with defect tags and the gold disposition (admit / repair / quarantine / reject) written before any gate ran. Two crossings (rq-10, rr-13) are formally perfect and wrong: the ceiling every strategy shares.
